name: B10-0436/2026 – § 6 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the pilot project on European Schools Alliances
part_text: 6.Encourages the pilot to support accessible and inclusive pupil and teacher mobility, including through group exchanges, collaborative teaching, peer learning, digital cooperation and the exchange of innovative and inclusive teaching practices; demands that student exchanges under the European Schools Alliances are limited to the 27 Member States of the European Union and the European Economic Area countries Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, and do not extend to other non-EU countries;
